newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's UES Q1 97 accruals pretax 369 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia's UES Q1 97 accruals pretax 369 bln rbls.

text.p: Russia's biggest company by sales, national power utility UES, had a first quarter unconsolidated pre-tax profit of 368.70 billion roubles ($64 million), prepared to Russian standards on an accruals basis, after 172.33 billion roubles in the first quarter of 1996, the company said on Thursday.
Sales were 3.10 trillion roubles after 2.52 trillion roubles in the first quarter of 1996. UES gave the following details: ($ = 5762 Russian Roubles)
NOTES -- Figures prepared to Russian accounting standards on an accruals basis. Full company name is RAO Yedinaya Energeticheskaya Sistema Rossii (UES).

Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble. Russia's year-on-year consumer price inflation in March 1997 was 16.7 percent.
